sketch: Workspace demo: the lowercase word "hello" in the middle of a canvas. In an intro step the letters stagger in, each scaling up, sliding from a start position, and fading in; in an outro step they shrink, drift to an end position, and vanish. The piece is exported as PNG, MP4, or WebM.

values.name: aspect
values.label: Aspect ratio
values.usage: Sets the shape of the composition frame and the exported file.

values.name: background
values.label: Background
values.type: list of color stops { hex, alpha, position 0-100 }
values.usage: A top-to-bottom wash painted behind the letters.

values.name: ink
values.label: Letters
values.usage: Fill color of every letter.

values.name: size
values.label: Letter size (% of height)
values.usage: Font size of the word as a percentage of the composition height, for the whole piece.

values.name: exportFormat
values.label: Export format
values.usage: File type written when the person clicks Export.

values.name: longEdge
values.label: Long edge (px)
values.usage: Pixel length of the longer side of the exported file; the other side follows the aspect ratio.

values.name: fps
values.label: Frame rate (fps)
values.usage: Frames per second of exported video.

values.name: transparent
values.label: Transparent background
values.usage: When true, a PNG export leaves out the background so only the letters are drawn.

values.name: theme
values.label: Theme
values.usage: Colors of the editor's panels and controls; the artwork keeps its own colors.

values.name: panelOpen
values.label: Controls panel open
values.usage: Whether the editor's left panel is expanded or collapsed to an icon button.

values.name: playing
values.label: Playing
values.usage: Whether the animation is currently advancing in the preview.

values.name: time
values.label: Playhead
values.usage: The moment of the sequence currently drawn in the preview.

values.name: selection
values.label: Selected step or element
values.type: { step: id, track: id or null }
values.usage: Which step or animated element the editor is currently showing details for.

values.name: introDuration
values.label: Intro duration (s)
values.usage: Length of the intro step; its keyframes rescale with it.

values.name: scaleKeyframes
values.label: Scale keyframes
values.type: { start, end } seconds within the step
values.usage: When the scale animation of the intro begins and ends inside the step.

values.name: scaleEase
values.label: Scale ease
values.usage: How the letters' scale accelerates and overshoots between the start and end keyframes.

values.name: scaleFrom
values.label: Start scale (×)
values.usage: Scale each letter starts at in the intro before growing to full size.

values.name: slideFrom
values.label: Start position
values.type: { x, y } percent of the composition, 50/50 is the rest position
values.usage: Where each letter starts in the intro before sliding to its place in the word.

values.name: letterLength
values.label: Letter length (% of clip)
values.usage: How much of an animated element's clip each letter takes; smaller values spread the letters out in a stagger.

values.name: order
values.label: Order
values.usage: Whether the stagger of an animated element runs from the first letter to the last or the reverse.

values.name: vanishTo
values.label: End position
values.type: { x, y } percent of the composition, 50/50 is the rest position
values.usage: Where each letter drifts to while vanishing in the outro.

values.name: fontWeight
values.label: Font weight
values.usage: Weight of the font used to draw every letter of the word.

values.name: textBaseline
values.label: Text baseline
values.usage: Set so each letter is drawn vertically centered on its anchor point.

values.name: staggerIndex
values.label: Letter stagger position
values.usage: Computed per letter from its index in the word to offset its timing within the stagger.
